title: Direct-agent proof: NVIDIA hardware discovery
description: Standalone node agent discovers NVIDIA GPU hardware via go-nvml (count, model, VRAM, UUID). No control plane, no PostgreSQL, no ConnectRPC — agent reports inventory locally. Phase B adds registration with control plane.

logs.msg: Research validated: CDI (Container Device Interface) provides vendor-agnostic GPU container injection without K8s. go-nvml (v0.13.0, 428★, NVIDIA-maintained CGo bindings) is sufficient for GPU inventory/health. No K8s required — just NVIDIA drivers + nvidia-container-toolkit + CDI spec generation.
Closed: this inference/direct-agent proof is out of scope until the Rust resource/lease kernel exists. The Go scaffold that these tasks targeted was deleted.
